original.statement: The deprecated CLI flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed and is no longer honoured.

decision.reason: The 1.16 upgrade notes, under "Removed Options", say "The deprecated flag `enable-remote-node-identity` has been removed" [ev-b8b62ef806f0]. That supports a cli-flag subject named --enable-remote-node-identity, with the leading -- added by the family convention. The text names no specific component. The change type is "removed". The sibling items in the same section [ev-e477115a445b][ev-91fac6720d6f] use the same "flag ... has been removed" wording, which fits reading these as removed command-line options.
